ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use Rundll32 - PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use Rundll32 in Scripts Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\&\\&.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*rundll32.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*shell32\\\.dll.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*shellexec\\_rundll.*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*value.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*invoke.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*comspec.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*iex.*")))
